body:
closes https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaDiagnostics.jl/issues/186 - This PR updates all the writers so that the times are saved at the beginning of the time reduction instead of at the end. On `main`, this behavior is only true for the `NetCDFWriter`, but now it is true for all writers. 

To handle this, we now keep track of the intervals of the window of each diagnostic in the `DiagnosticHandler` and update them whenever the writers write data.
title: Make saved times consistent across writers
